role_voices.text_zh: 不要怕……我不會拿走你的肚臍。
role_voices.text_en: Don't be afraid... I'm not going to steal your belly button.

role_voices.text_zh: 今年鬼島的收成很好，大家都很開心，我也很高興。
role_voices.text_en: The harvest on Ghost Island has been great this year. Everyone is happy, and so am I.

role_voices.text_zh: 別看我這樣，我也是鬼島的守護神。
role_voices.text_en: Don't underestimate me, I am a guardian spirit of Ghost Island, after all.

role_voices.text_zh: ……願意主動接近我的人，你是第一個。
role_voices.text_en: ...You're the first person willing to approach me directly.

role_voices.text_zh: 我的眼神總是被說很兇……只有你說可愛。
role_voices.text_en: People always say that my eyes look fierce... you're the only one that's called me cute.

role_voices.text_zh: 需要幫忙嗎？我剛好有空。
role_voices.text_en: Need some help? I happen to be free right now.
Hmm... if you touch me like that... it tickles...

role_voices.text_zh: 因為你很好，所以我想要更認識你。
role_voices.text_en: Because you're a nice guy, I want to get to know you better.

role_voices.text_zh: 道歉要露出胸部……你沒有騙我吧？
role_voices.text_en: I need to expose my breasts to apologize...? You aren't lying to me, are you?
So this is the extent of your strength.
